_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'We discover, develop, manufacture, and market products in two business segments—human pharmaceutical products and animal health products.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection; if our intellectual property rights are invalidated or circumvented, our business will be adversely affected.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'We depend on patent-protected products for most of our revenues, cash flows, and earnings, and we will lose effective intellectual property protection for many of them in the next several years.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1A); 'Seven significant patent-protected products, which together composed 68 percent of our worldwide revenue in 2012, recently have lost, or will lose in the next several years, their most significant remaining U.S. patent protection and data-based protection' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1A); 'Loss of exclusivity, whether by expiration or as a consequence of litigation, typically results in a rapid and severe decline in sales.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product revenues can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic versions of our branded products, and by generic versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.0%/yr (worst year FY03-FY13 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-15.6%/yr (FY14 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.2%/yr (FY03-FY13 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY13 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2014-01-31) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.26x (79.6% downside to Bear $11 / +35.2% upside to Bull $73) | Adj composite 1.85 vs market 2.84: gap -0.99 [OVERVALUED] | +37% above the EPP floor $39 (14x FY14E $2.81) | Conservative 2-yr case: -30.1% total (-15.0%/yr) | At 19.2x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $71 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues -6.0% in Q4 2013, forward revenues -16.9% to -14.3% (FY14 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
